instruction: I want to try the experimental tab groups feature in Chrome. Please enable the tab groups experiment for me.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the tab groups experiment (tab-groups) in Chrome flags. Uses existing check_enabled_experiments metric. Similar complexity to original - accessing chrome://flags and enabling one experiment.

llm_judge_reasons: Incorrect comparison logic in check_enabled_experiments metric (chrome.py:491)
Metric uses exact equality check (enabled_experiments_names == rule['names']) which requires ONLY tab-groups to be enabled
Instruction asks to 'enable the tab groups experiment', not 'enable ONLY the tab groups experiment'
Will fail if user has any other Chrome experiments enabled (default or user-enabled), even though task was completed correctly
Correct logic should check if 'tab-groups' is IN the list of enabled experiments, not exact equality
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change metric logic in chrome.py:491 from exact equality to subset check: 'return 1. if set(rule['names']).issubset(set(enabled_experiments_names)) else 0.'
This would correctly verify that tab-groups is enabled regardless of other experiments
Alternative: Update expected to use a different rule type that supports 'contains' rather than exact match
